en: Sepia-toned postcard showing an old, somewhat dilapidated multi‑storey manor or palace-like building beside a pond or moat. Leafless trees stand in front of the facade, partially obscuring tall arched windows and open loggias or balconies. A small figure walks at the far left and a horse and cart stand to the right. The reflection of the building is visible in the still water in the foreground. Handwritten text appears faintly at the lower left of the image.
